A '''seeping elm tree''' is a tree found only in [[Daemonheim]]. It requires 10 [[Woodcutting]] to be chopped and can yield 1-6 [[Seeping elm branches]] before depletion. Each of the logs give 60 experience. High [[complexity]] is required to find this tree whilst Dungeoneering.
